analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-buffer-overflow is caused by parse_data_sgroup() unconditionally incrementing the iterator after each field parse (lines around 667, 669, 677, 684, 689, 694) without verifying that read_text_to() actually stopped on a delimiter within bounds. For malformed/truncated SgD CXSMILES blocks, read_text_to() can advance first to last, then ++first moves it past end; subsequent read_text_to() dereferences this invalid iterator in its loop condition (via *first), producing the 1-byte OOB read reported at read_text_to() line 143.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must reach CXSMILES extension parsing through MolDataStreamToMol -> ParseMolBlockProperties -> ParseMarvinSmartsLine -> SmartsToMol -> parseCXExtensions, and include an SgD data SGroup token ("SgD:") with missing/insufficient ':'-separated fields or truncated tail so delimiters are absent. Then parse_data_sgroup() repeatedly does ++first past end and later calls read_text_to() with first > last, triggering out-of-bounds read.
